why: Read ir_fa.tags.json's `why` first. This is the UNARY member of the float tranche: two parameters instead of three, and the only chained body whose emitted instruction is a `unop`. Until now `unop` had battery rows only from the W2a SYNTHETIC lane (`synth_chains.rs`), whose header names it among "the constructors no emitted body exercises". how_it_is_used: `ir_mint::mint` reads this table to check the callee namespace (empty lane = a module with no `call`); `ir_mint::project` reads the `interface` block in the other direction and REFUSES a fixture whose header or parameter types are not the pinned ones.

The sharp slot is the ARITY as much as the width: `bb0(%0: ptr, %1: f64)` is two parameters where every other float chain has three, and a `unop` core module read against a binary interface would mismatch here rather than silently take the wrong operand.
